main_text.p: נֶגֶב m. Auster, Meridies, Tractus meridianus, Plaga australis.
נֶגֶד Coram, Contra, Ante, E regione, Ex adverso. Chald. idem.
נְגַד Chald. Manavit, Profluxit, Traxit se. הִגִּיד Hiphil Narravit, Annunciavit, Indicavit, Retulit.
נָגִיד m. Princeps, Antistes, Dux, Praesul.
נָגַהּ Splenduit. Hiphil הִגְיִיהּ Splendere fecit.
נֹגַהּ f. Splendor: plur. נְגֹהוֹת. Chal. בִּנְגַהָּא Cum luce, Dan. 6.20.
נָגַף Ferire, Petere, Impetere cornibus. Hithpahel הִתְנַגַּף Confligere.
נָגַן Pihel נִגֵּן Pulsare instrumentum musicum. נְגָנִים Pulsatores, Fidicines.
מְנַגִּינָה, מְנִינָה f. Pulsatio: plur. נְגִינוֹת.

נָגַע Tangere, Attingere, Pertingere: Ledere, Percutere, Plagis afficere. Niphal נִגַּע Percuti. Pihel נִגַּע, Percußit, Plagâ affecit. Hiphil הִנִּיעַ Pertingere fecit, Admovit, Conjunxit, & intransitivè, Pertingere, Pervenire.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-style vocalisation approximated; the scan is small and the pointing is hard to confirm letter by letter. Bottom right Hebrew word (נגע) is a catchword or signature, uncertain.
